currentRoundInspection.scope: One detailed daylight exterior and one whole-building river-context picture;standard viewer PMTiles/DEM and retained reference identity. Images viewed only,not shipped.

pictures.author: Balon Greyjoy (uploader;no machine-readable author listed)
pictures.observations: Daylight near exterior: red brick and broad pale bands,tall paired tower vocabulary with cream balconies and open lantern cap,small corner chhatris,white onion domes,cream cusped arch frames,flat dark roof edging and pale parapet points. Fine decorative lattice,flags and loudspeakers are omitted.

pictures.author: Alexey Komarov
pictures.observations: Whole mosque at night from the river confluence: three principal pale domes with a larger central bulb,paired minarets,low repeating front arches and small edge pinnacles. This distant view establishes setting and broad silhouette only;night lighting,mist,signage and neighboring towers are not part of the model.
